notes.title: "shadow heroes" V1.0.2 version has been updated
notes.notes:
Dear players, this update mainly fixes bugs that cannot be obtained by achievements.

Thank you for experiencing the new version, and you can reply your suggestions or comments to us through the forum. We will also listen to and absorb the improved game.

notes.title: "shadow heroes" V1.0.1 version has been updated
"shadow heroes" trial version has been released
notes.notes:
Dear players, the trial version of the game has been released. If you like this game, please join the wish list, and we will release the official version next month.

Game link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2089920/Shadow_Heroes/
